policy: The default bootstrap reproduces the exact 2026-07-14 MediaWiki 1.46 distribution-line snapshot. Every upstream input is obtained from an exact Git commit. MediaWiki core, Vector, DarkMode, Popups, Cite, and TextExtracts use exact REL1_46 commits; Codex styles, design tokens, mixins, and icon-path variables are built from the exact matching design-codex Git tag. Upstream movement occurs only through an explicit bootstrap refresh or release option. The final stylesheet cascade is generated from source-derived MediaWiki queue events and the locked ClientHtml::makeLoad module sorting/source-group partition algorithm rather than a hand-authored CSS import list.

repositories.name: mediawiki-skins-Vector
repositories.scope: Vector legacy templates, PHP data contracts, LESS, and JavaScript behavior sources

repositories.name: mediawiki
repositories.scope: MediaWiki core skinning LESS, ResourceLoader SkinModule and core module registry sources, default variables, and core Codex module CSS sources

repositories.name: mediawiki-extensions-DarkMode
repositories.scope: DarkMode extension hook, message, client behavior, and ext.DarkMode.styles ResourceLoader sources

repositories.name: mediawiki-extensions-Popups
repositories.scope: Popups page activation, runtime loader queue, selector, title, model, gateway, renderer, templates, thumbnail, timing, messages, icons, and ResourceLoader style references

repositories.name: mediawiki-extensions-Cite
repositories.scope: Cite parser-output style enqueue source, ext.cite.styles, ReferencePreviews plugin registration, selector, gateway, renderer, messages, and LESS sources

repositories.name: mediawiki-extensions-TextExtracts
repositories.scope: TextExtracts first-section and formatter behavior contracts used by the page-preview adapter

repositories.name: design-codex
repositories.scope: Complete locked Codex workspace source used by the upstream build, plus selected generated CSS, token, mixin, icon-path, and SVG vendor outputs

bootstrap.transaction: A refresh or release candidate replaces the lock and manifest only when clone, repository-local upstream builds, materialization, generation, and generated-output freshness checks all succeed.
bootstrap.toolingInstall: Root tooling and project-owned upstream build toolchains use npm ci with their distributed package-lock.json files. The lock files are treated as immutable inputs and any attempted mutation fails.
bootstrap.vendorProvenance: Every vendor input comes from an exact Git checkout. Upstream packages that publish generated distributions are rebuilt inside their locked checkout before vendor materialization.

notes: The distributed archive intentionally excludes vendor/, .upstream/, generated CSS/Vue outputs, runtime assets, node_modules/, and upstream build outputs.
The default bootstrap never resolves moving branch heads; it checks out the exact commits recorded above.
--refresh resolves the newest heads of the currently locked release line and is explicit.
--release X.Y resolves RELX_Y explicitly; it does not silently detect or adopt a new stable release.
Before every run, materialized vendor files and generated outputs are removed. Existing Git checkouts are reset, cleaned including ignored files, and detached at the exact locked commit.

Repositories without upstream build steps use sparse checkout from the declared source inventory. Build-bearing repositories may set sparseCheckout to false so the exact upstream build receives its complete source workspace instead of a guessed file subset.
The design-codex repository is checked out completely at its locked commit, linked to the pinned project-owned build toolchain, and built through its own workspace scripts.

The DarkMode extension is locked to the same MediaWiki release line. Its ResourceLoader style module is generated from upstream LESS; the thetree theme state is only adapted to the extension-owned html class contract.

The final page stylesheet imports are generated from locked parser-output, skin-option, BeforePageDisplay, runtime loader, extension-attribute, and on-demand module sources. OutputPage enqueue order and ClientHtml::makeLoad sorting/source-group partitioning are both verified against the locked MediaWiki core source; css/screen.css does not hand-order upstream ResourceLoader modules.
invariants: The final page stylesheet imports are generated from locked parser-output, skin-option, BeforePageDisplay, runtime loader, extension-attribute, and on-demand module sources. OutputPage enqueue order is verified, then head style modules are serialized by the locked ClientHtml::makeLoad sort and source/group partition algorithm; css/screen.css does not hand-order upstream ResourceLoader modules.
